notes.text:
FUNCTIONAL STATUS:
Patient ambulates independently throughout the home without an assistive device. Showers independently.

MEDICATIONS:
Lisinopril 20 mg daily, furosemide 20 mg daily, atorvastatin 40 mg nightly. Patient manages own medications.

HOSPITAL COURSE:
Admitted 10/12 for acute on chronic heart failure exacerbation. Diuresed with IV furosemide.

DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS:
Furosemide increased to 40 mg daily. Lisinopril discontinued due to acute kidney injury. Started metoprolol succinate 25 mg daily. Continue atorvastatin 40 mg nightly.

FUNCTIONAL STATUS:
Ambulation: Pt ambulates 50 ft with a rolling walker and contact guard assist from therapist; limited by dyspnea.
Bathing: Pt requires hands-on assistance of one person to step into the tub and to wash lower body.
Dressing: Pt dresses upper body independently; requires assistance to put on socks and shoes.

ASSESSMENT/PLAN:
Deconditioned after hospitalization. PT 3x/week for strengthening and endurance.

MEDICATIONS:
Wife now fills the weekly pillbox and reminds patient at each dose; patient takes the medications himself.
